events.body:
## Context

README badges and links, CONTRIBUTING clone/issue/PR steps, the `public/index.html` footer and `lib/src/constants/socialurls_constants.dart` (used by the About screen) still point at github.com/OWASP, including a BLT-Bacon repo that isn't in the monorepo.

## What to do

1. Map links to `https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/BLT-Core`, `/BLT-Extension`, `/BLT-Action`, `/BLT-Flutter` and `https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/issues`.
2. Drop the Bacon link and the broken Actions badge.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `grep -rn "github.com/OWASP" blt-flutter --exclude-dir=ios --exclude-dir=android` is empty
- [ ] `flutter analyze` clean

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-flutter/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
cd blt-flutter && flutter analyze
```

---
Size: **S**. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
